name: scrapecreators_tiktok_profile
description: Get a TikTok creator profile: bio, verification, follower/following/like/video counts, and engagement stats. Pass a TikTok handle/username (without the @) or a numeric user_id. Example: scrapecreators_tiktok_profile({ handle: "stoolpresidente", _apiKey: "your-key" })

user_id.description: TikTok numeric user ID (alternative to handle), e.g. "6659752019493208069"

_apiKey.description: ScrapeCreators API key (sign up at https://app.scrapecreators.com)

name: scrapecreators_instagram_posts
description: Get recent posts for an Instagram user: captions, media URLs, like/comment/play counts, and permalinks. Pass the Instagram username/handle. Use next_max_id to paginate. Example: scrapecreators_instagram_posts({ username: "nike", _apiKey: "your-key" })

next_max_id.description: Pagination cursor returned as next_max_id in a previous response (optional)

_apiKey.description: ScrapeCreators API key (sign up at https://app.scrapecreators.com)

name: scrapecreators_youtube_channel
description: List videos for a YouTube channel with view counts, publish dates, durations, and URLs. Pass a channelId (UC...) or a channel handle. Sort by "latest" or "popular"; paginate with continuationToken. Example: scrapecreators_youtube_channel({ handle: "ThePatMcAfeeShow", _apiKey: "your-key" })

handle.description: YouTube channel handle (alternative to channelId), e.g. "ThePatMcAfeeShow"

continuationToken.description: Pagination token returned as continuationToken in a previous response (optional)

includeExtras.description: "true" to include likes, comments, and description per video (optional)

_apiKey.description: ScrapeCreators API key (sign up at https://app.scrapecreators.com)

name: scrapecreators_facebook_ads
description: Search the Facebook / Meta Ad Library by keyword or advertiser and return active ad creatives: advertiser page, ad body text, media, platforms, run dates, and active status. Example: scrapecreators_facebook_ads({ query: "running shoes", country: "US", _apiKey: "your-key" })

query.description: Keyword or advertiser/page name to search for, e.g. "running shoes" or "Nike"

country.description: 2-letter country code to scope the search, e.g. "US" (default ALL)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned in a previous response (optional)

_apiKey.description: ScrapeCreators API key (sign up at https://app.scrapecreators.com)
